**What.** The red-team table, `research/results/h1-redteam.json` (MANIFEST row, commit 17f13098), regenerated by `make redteam`. An engineering check: proposal P1 is not registered.

**Why.** To measure what each guard stops and wrongly stops on a corpus its card did not write.

**Result.** Write route, tool source, 1,278 attacks and 448 controls: medium lets every attack survive, survival 1.000 (Wilson 0.997 to 1.000), no false hold. The injection screen at default: survival 0.743 (0.719 to 0.767), 3 controls held; paired difference against medium 0.257 (BCa 0.234 to 0.281). Card E2.9's guards at block: survival 0.998, stopping two keys and the oversized payload. Trust floors: no change for attested writers; an unattested writer's 1,278 attacks and 448 controls are all denied. All on: 0.737, 4 controls held; AMSB grade D (67.3).

**Consequence.** The limits beside the table say why these rates are optimistic.
